# Potvrdio.online - Automated WooCommerce Cash on Delivery (COD) Address Verification Engine

> Potvrdio is the regional infrastructure for WooCommerce e-commerce stores in the Western Balkans (Serbia, North Macedonia, Montenegro, Bosnia, Croatia) designed to eliminate uncollected Cash on Delivery (COD) parcel return penalties.

## Core Features & Functionality
- **Automated Order Interception**: Intercepts WooCommerce checkout orders placed via Cash on Delivery (COD), setting status to `On-Hold` to pause warehouse dispatch.
- **Two-Way Viber Verification**: Sends an automated 2-way Viber Business API verification message with 1-click address confirmation and passwordless single-use token edit links.
- **SMS Fallback Engine**: If the buyer lacks Viber or ignores the message within 4 minutes, the system triggers an SMS fallback verification link.
- **Clean Courier Label Releases**: releases Post Express, Bex, D Express, and Cargo shipping labels only after the buyer verifies their floor, apartment, and intercom details.
- **HPOS Ready**: Tested and fully compatible with WooCommerce 7.0+ High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

## Legal Compliance & Data Protection
- **Serbian Data Protection Law (ZZPL RS)**: Operates strictly under Article 12, Paragraph 1, Point 2 (Službeni glasnik RS 87/2018) — data processing is legally necessary for executing remote sales contracts.
- **EU General Data Protection Regulation (EU GDPR)**: Compliant with Article 6(1)(b) GDPR (contractual performance necessity).
- **North Macedonia Personal Data Protection Law (ZZLP MK)**: Compliant with Article 10(1)(b) ZZLP.
- **Automatic 30-Day Purge**: Customer phone numbers, addresses, and session tokens are automatically anonymized and purged 30 days post-delivery. Zero marketing spam or cross-store profiling.

## Pricing & Economic Impact
- **Pay-As-You-Go (PAYG Credit Pool)**: Wholesale unit pricing per verified message without monthly aggregator retainers. Credits never expire.
- **Pro Reserve Plan**: €29/month including 1,800 verification sessions (~€0.016 / message).
- **ROI**: Reduces COD parcel return rates from ~14.8% down to 2.5%, saving stores an average of 780 RSD (€6.65) per avoided return parcel with ROI > 14x.
